# Badge

A badge is a small visual indicator used to show counts, status, or to draw attention to an element.

## When to Use

- Notification counts
- Status indicators
- New/unread markers
- Numeric labels on icons or buttons

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `Badge` | Status/count indicator |
